title: Less value and weird toys
text: I bought this monthly toy box because it was on promotion and I thought these toys will be fun for my son and he should be happy to get them each month.  But things really go south when we first opened at Christmas.  First, the toys we received did not include popular figures and we don't even know where they are coming from(unknown films).  Moreover, these toys have quality problems and are not well detailed.  We ended up returning it and it is not worth it or exciting. They just put overstock toys in the box that are not selling well.
label: negative
